source.title: NEC User's Guide, Part III (NEC-2), Examples 1 and 3
source.authors: G. J. Burke and A. J. Poggio
source.note: Expected values are transcribed from the printed NEC-2 output in the manual. They are not generated by the implementation under test.

comparison.note: Absolute tolerance per complex component. nec2c reproduces the printed manual values to the precision printed in the manual.

cases.name: nec2_manual_example1
cases.description: NEC-2 User's Guide Example 1: center-fed linear antenna, free space, 7 segments, 0.5 m, radius 1 mm, default frequency 299.8 MHz.

cases.name: nec2_manual_example3_perfect
cases.description: NEC-2 User's Guide Example 3: vertical half-wave antenna over perfect ground, 30 MHz, extended thin-wire kernel.

cases.name: nec2_manual_example3_finite
cases.description: NEC-2 User's Guide Example 3: vertical half-wave antenna over finite ground (eps_r=6, sigma=1e-3 S/m), 30 MHz, extended thin-wire kernel.

cases.name: scaled_example1_7mhz
cases.description: Frequency-scaled version of Example 1 at 7.1 MHz. Geometry and radius are scaled by the wavelength ratio; the expected value is therefore the Example 1 value, with a wider tolerance for rounding in the scaled coordinates.

smoke_cases.name: dipole_sweep_pattern
smoke_cases.description: 40 m band dipole, 21 segments, 1 mm radius, 21 frequencies and one elevation pattern cut.
